name: Ki ni Naru Kanojo no Mama wa Gen'eki Mahou Shoujo - Shiborare Sandwich Seikatsu
original_name: 気になる彼女のママは現役魔法少女 搾られサンドウィッチ生活
source:
Aside from his unusual ability to see things not of this world, Sumiyoshi Dai is an ordinary student. Lately, however, he finds himself drawn to his classmate, Hougetsu Aqua.

One day, he goes to her house to hang out. There, he meets Aqua's mother, Hougetsu Ruby.

Through an unexpected turn of events, he learns that Ruby is an active mahou shoujo - and soon, he's swept up in a series of mysterious incidents.

Before long, he ends up providing Ruby with his semen as a source of magical energy, and the two gradually deepen their relationship.

With Ruby's daughter Aqua, a mysterious woman named Kagami, and a girl named Dia who claims to be Ruby's mentor all drawn into the mix, a string of strange, sex-filled days begins.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/mahou/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
除了具有非凡的观察非这个世界事物的能力之外，戴住吉还是一名普通的学生。然而最近，他发现自己被他的同学凤月阿克娅所吸引。

有一天，他去她家闲逛。在那里，他遇到了阿克娅的母亲，凤月红宝石。

通过意想不到的事件，他得知露比是一名活跃的魔法少女 - 很快，他就卷入了一系列神秘事件。

不久，他将自己的精液作为魔法能量的来源提供给鲁比，两人的关系逐渐加深。

鲁比的女儿阿克娅、神秘女子加贺美以及自称是鲁比导师的女孩迪亚都被卷入其中，一连串奇怪、充满性的日子开始了。

[翻译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/mahou/index.html#story]官网[/url]]
